mentions.name: Nonoverse
mentions.description: This game generates nonogram puzzles that are fun to solve, with distinct level styles defined by the creator, somewhat like Minecraft biomes. A small-but-difficult low density puzzle set has been released and larger puzzles are in development, with a daily puzzle available at lab174.com/nonodle/.
mentions.audience: Puzzle players who enjoy solving nonograms
mentions.source_excerpt:
Generating nonogram puzzles that are fun to solve. I define different level styles, a bit like minecraft biomes.

I just released a small-but-difficult low density set which I like a lot. I’m starting work on larger puzzles (second or third attempt).

Screens and download: https://lab174.com/nonoverse/

There is also a daily puzzle at: https://lab174.com/nonodle/
